$comment: THE ONE STATEMENT of which confidential provider routes AnonRouter offers.
A route is identified by provider + canonical model + privacy class, and all
three are load-bearing. Provider alone is too coarse: Venice serves nine e2ee
routes and only some verify. Model alone is worse than useless: `z-ai/glm-5.1`
is served by Venice as BOTH an `e2ee` route and a `private` route, so a
model-only rule would take down a working private route while trying to
withhold a broken encrypted one, and `openai/gpt-oss-120b` would lose its
Tinfoil TEE route to a decision about Venice.
THIS FILE IS DATA, NOT A SWITCH. Moving a route from `withheld` to `verified`
is a claim that it verified, and the gate that claim has to clear is written
into `reEnableGate` below rather than left to judgement.
An ALLOWLIST, not a denylist, and the direction is the point. A Venice
e2ee route that appears in the catalog tomorrow is withheld until
somebody measures it, rather than offered until somebody notices it is
broken. Adding a tenth route therefore fails a test instead of shipping
itself.
Chutes evidence verifies on all four measured routes, but the deployed
content plane cannot admit opaque encrypted inputs for routes whose maximum
context exceeds its 200,000-token ceiling. Only the two routes that fit that
ceiling are offered. This is an admission property, not an attestation failure.

$comment: What it takes to move a route from `withheld` to `verified`. Written down
because the failure mode is a single lucky sample: Venice's outages are
time-correlated, so three quick retries can all land in one good window
just as easily as one bad one.
reEnableGate.interleavedMeaning: Samples must be separated by a full pass over the other routes, not taken back to back. `npm run example:route-matrix` in the SDK does this; a loop that retries one route until it passes does not, and that defect is what produced a wrong count once already.
reEnableGate.requiredChecks: every required check passing on every sample; a single 503 anywhere in the window disqualifies the run
evidenceRequired: a content-free route-matrix run showing the route trusted on both hops
the per-round outcome table, so a reviewer can see the samples were spread rather than clustered
the nested attestation document present and binding, for the three routes withheld for insufficient evidence
reEnableGate.approval: owner. Moving an entry is a change to what customers are offered and is not a maintenance edit.

$comment: Withholding is about what a customer can CALL, not about what anyone can
MEASURE. A withheld route stays measurable, because re-qualifying it is the
only way it ever comes back and Venice evidence is only reachable through
the ticketed path.
The affordance is narrow on purpose: an attestation ticket is not a route to
inference. It reserves no funds, carries no content, and redeems to evidence
and nothing else. So a probe ticket for a withheld route grants exactly the
ability to see why it is withheld.
